title: AI in Our School Life
titleZh: 我们学校生活中的人工智能
topic: 人工智能在校园生活中的应用
passage:
Artificial intelligence (AI) is coming into our school life. It is changing the way we learn and play.

In our school, AI helps teachers mark homework. It can check hundreds of papers in a minute. Then teachers have more time to help students. AI can also make learning plans for each student. If you are weak in math, it will give you more math exercises. If you are good at English, it will give you harder reading tasks.

Some students use AI to learn at home. A boy named Li Ming uses an AI app to practice English speaking. The app listens to him and tells him how to say words better. "It is like a patient teacher," he says. "It never gets angry."

But AI is not always good. Some students just copy answers from AI. They don't think by themselves. That is bad for learning. Our teacher says, "AI is a tool, not a brain. You must use it in the right way."

AI will be more and more important in the future. We should learn to use it well. It can help us, but we must also keep thinking on our own.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: AI can only help teachers mark homework.

choices.label: B
choices.text: AI is changing school life but we should use it correctly.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Students should not use AI at all.

choices.label: D
choices.text: AI will replace teachers in the future.

questions.explanation: 文章既讲了AI在学校中的多种用途，也提到要正确使用，不能只抄答案，所以B正确。A太片面，只提到一个用途；C与文章相反，文章说AI有用；D文章未提及替代老师。

questions.question: How does AI help teachers according to the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It teaches students new subjects.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It marks homework and makes learning plans.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It cleans the classroom.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It talks to parents.

questions.explanation: 文章第二段说AI帮助老师批改作业和制定学习计划，所以B正确。A、C、D文章均未提到。

questions.question: What can we infer about Li Ming from the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: He doesn't like his English teacher.

choices.label: B
choices.text: He thinks the AI app is helpful.

choices.label: C
choices.text: He is good at English.

choices.label: D
choices.text: He uses AI to copy answers.

questions.explanation: 李明说AI像有耐心的老师，从不生气，说明他认为AI有帮助，所以B正确。A文章未提及他不喜欢老师；C文章未说他的英语水平；D文章说有些学生抄答案，但不是李明。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "patient" mean in the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: 能忍耐的

choices.label: B
choices.text: 生病的

choices.label: C
choices.text: 聪明的

choices.label: D
choices.text: 严格的

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，李明说AI像有耐心的老师，从不生气，所以patient意思是“能忍耐的、有耐心的”，选A。B是“生病的”，C是“聪明的”，D是“严格的”，都不符合语境。

title: Why Dogs Tilt Their Heads
titleZh: 狗为什么会歪头
passage:
Many dog owners see their dogs tilt their heads. It looks cute, but it may have a real reason. Scientists studied this behavior and found some interesting facts.

First, dogs tilt their heads to hear better. Their ears can turn to catch sounds. When a sound comes from a strange place, a dog may tilt its head to find it. This helps the dog know where the sound is.

Second, dogs tilt their heads to see better. A dog's nose is long. It can block part of the dog's view. By tilting its head, the dog can see your face more clearly. This is important when it tries to understand your words.

Third, dogs tilt their heads to show feelings. When a dog hears a word it knows, like "walk" or "treat", it may tilt its head. This shows it is listening and interested. It may also want you to repeat the word.

So, the next time your dog tilts its head, it is not just being cute. It is trying to hear you, see you, and understand you better.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Dogs tilt their heads only because it is cute.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Dogs tilt their heads for several real reasons.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Dogs tilt their heads to show they are hungry.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Dogs tilt their heads to make friends with people.

questions.explanation: 文章第一段指出狗歪头看起来可爱，但可能有真实原因，随后列举了三个原因：听得更清楚、看得更清楚、表达情感。因此主旨是狗歪头有多个真实原因，选B。A项说“只是因为可爱”，与文章意思相反；C项“表示饿了”文中未提及；D项“为了和人交朋友”文中也没有提到。

questions.question: According to the passage, why do dogs tilt their heads when they hear a strange sound?

choices.label: A
choices.text: To make the sound softer.

choices.label: B
choices.text: To find where the sound comes from.

choices.label: C
choices.text: To show they are not afraid.

choices.label: D
choices.text: To tell other dogs about the sound.

questions.explanation: 文章第二段提到，当声音来自陌生的地方时，狗会歪头来找到声音的位置（find it）。因此B项“找到声音来自哪里”正确。A项“让声音变柔和”文中未提；C项“表示不害怕”文中未提；D项“告诉其他狗”文中也未提。

questions.question: What can we infer from the passage about a dog's nose?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It helps the dog hear better.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It is shorter than a human's nose.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It may stop the dog from seeing clearly.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It makes the dog tilt its head to smell.

questions.explanation: 文章第三段说狗的鼻子长，会挡住部分视线（block part of the dog's view），歪头可以看得更清楚。由此可推断，狗的鼻子可能妨碍它看清东西，选C。A项“帮助听得更好”与鼻子无关；B项“比人的鼻子短”与文中“长鼻子”相反；D项“让狗歪头去闻”文中未提。

questions.question: What does the word "treat" mean in the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A kind of food for dogs.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A way to train dogs.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A place to walk dogs.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A sound dogs make.

questions.explanation: 文章第四段提到狗听到“walk”或“treat”这类它知道的词会歪头。结合语境，“walk”是散步，“treat”应与狗喜欢的事物并列，通常指给狗的零食或奖励，所以选A“一种狗的食物”。B项“训练狗的方法”、C项“遛狗的地方”、D项“狗发出的声音”都不符合上下文。

title: A School Trip to the Space Museum
titleZh: 一次去太空博物馆的学校旅行
passage:
Last Friday, our class went to the Space Museum. We were all very excited. The museum was big and had many models of rockets and spaceships.

A guide met us at the door. She showed us a film about space travel. We saw astronauts walking in space. They looked like they were flying. It was so cool! The guide told us that astronauts must be healthy and strong. They also need to learn many things, like science and math.

Then we went to a room with a big rocket model. The guide said, "This rocket can go to the moon. But it needs a lot of fuel." We learned that space travel is not easy. It takes years of hard work.

After the visit, we had a quiz. Our teacher asked, "What do astronauts need to be?" We all answered, "Healthy and strong!"

I want to be an astronaut one day. I will study hard and exercise every day. Maybe I can travel to space and see the stars up close!

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Astronauts are very healthy and strong.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A class visit to the Space Museum and what they learned.

choices.label: C
choices.text: How to build a model rocket.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The history of space travel.

questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述了班级去太空博物馆参观的经历以及他们学到的东西。A选项只是其中一个细节；C选项文章未提到如何制作火箭模型；D选项文章未讲述太空旅行的历史。

questions.question: What did the guide say about astronauts?

choices.label: A
choices.text: They must be tall and strong.

choices.label: B
choices.text: They need to learn science and math.

choices.label: C
choices.text: They can travel to the moon easily.

choices.label: D
choices.text: They don't need much training.

questions.explanation: 文章中提到导游说宇航员需要学习科学和数学等许多东西。A选项文中说healthy and strong，不是tall；C选项文中说太空旅行不容易；D选项与原文相反。

questions.question: What can we infer about the writer from the last paragraph?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The writer is afraid of space travel.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The writer wants to be an astronaut in the future.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The writer thinks space travel is boring.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The writer doesn't like studying.

questions.explanation: 最后一段中作者说“I want to be an astronaut one day.”，表明作者想成为宇航员。A、C、D选项与文章内容不符。

questions.question: What does the word "fuel" in Paragraph 3 mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Something used to make a rocket go.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A kind of food for astronauts.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A tool for fixing rockets.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A place to store rockets.

questions.explanation: 根据上下文“This rocket can go to the moon. But it needs a lot of fuel.”可知，fuel是让火箭飞行的东西，即燃料。B、C、D选项不符合语境。

title: A Special Lunch at School
titleZh: 学校里的一顿特别午餐
passage:
Last Friday, our school had a special lunch. It was not the usual rice and meat. Every student got a box of food with a note. The note said, "Eat well, and learn about healthy eating."

In the box, there was a sandwich, an apple, some carrots, and a small bottle of milk. There was no candy or cola. At first, some students were not happy. "Where is the chicken?" asked Tom. "I want chips!" said Lucy. But Miss Li, our science teacher, smiled and said, "Try it first. Healthy food can be tasty, too."

We sat in groups and talked about the food. Anna said, "I often eat candy after school. Maybe I should eat fruit instead." Jack said, "I drink cola every day. I think water is better." Miss Li told us that too much sugar is bad for our teeth and body. She also said vegetables help us stay strong.

After lunch, we made a small plan. We wrote down one healthy change for the next week. I wrote: "No cola. Eat an apple every day." Now I know small changes can make a big difference.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Students should eat more chicken and chips.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A special lunch helped students learn about healthy eating.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Miss Li is a strict science teacher.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Candy and cola are the best food for students.

questions.explanation: 文章讲述学校通过一顿特别午餐让学生了解健康饮食，最后学生制定了健康改变计划，因此B是主旨。A与文中健康饮食主题相反；C只是文中提到的一个人物，不是主旨；D与文中观点相反。

questions.question: What was in the special lunch box?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Rice, meat and cola.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Candy, chips and milk.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A sandwich, an apple, carrots and milk.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Chicken, bread and juice.

questions.explanation: 文中明确提到盒子里有三明治、苹果、胡萝卜和一小瓶牛奶，因此C正确。A中的米饭、肉和可乐不是午餐盒内容；B中的糖果和薯片没有出现；D中的鸡肉和果汁也没有出现。

questions.question: Why did Miss Li ask students to try the food first?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Because she wanted them to find healthy food tasty.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because she wanted them to eat quickly.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Because the food was from her home.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because there was no other food at school.

questions.explanation: Miss Li说“先尝一尝，健康食物也可以很美味”，说明她希望学生发现健康食物好吃，因此A正确。B、C、D在文中没有依据，属于无中生有。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "change" mean in the last paragraph?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Something different you decide to do.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A kind of healthy food.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A note from the teacher.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A bottle of milk.

questions.explanation: 最后一段中，学生写下下周的一个健康改变，如“不喝可乐，每天吃一个苹果”，因此change指决定要做的不同的事情，A正确。B、C、D都是文中具体事物，不是change的意思。

title: A New Life in the City
titleZh: 城市新生活
passage:
Last year, Lily moved to a big city with her family. At first, she felt sad. She missed her old friends and the quiet life in her small town.

In the city, there were tall buildings and many cars. The streets were always busy. Lily's new school was very large. She was afraid to speak to her new classmates. She sat alone at lunch and thought about her old home.

One day, a girl named Amy sat next to her. Amy said, "You look new. Would you like to join our reading club?" Lily was surprised but happy. She said yes.

Now Lily goes to the reading club every Friday. She has made many friends. She also likes walking in the city park. "The city is different," she says. "But I am not sad now. I have a new life here."

Lily's mother is glad. She says, "Lily is brave. She tried new things and found her way." Lily learns that a new place can be scary, but it can also be full of surprises.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Lily misses her old friends very much.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Lily learns to enjoy her new life in the city.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Amy is a kind girl who likes reading books.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Living in a big city is better than living in a small town.

questions.explanation: 文章讲述了莉莉从最初不适应城市生活到后来结交朋友、喜欢上新生活的过程，因此主旨是B。A只是开头部分的内容，不是全文主旨；C是细节，不是主旨；D文中没有比较城市和城镇哪个更好，属于过度推断。

questions.question: How did Lily feel when she first moved to the city?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Excited.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Angry.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Sad.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Tired.

questions.explanation: 文章第一段明确提到“At first, she felt sad.”，所以答案是C。A、B、D在文中没有依据。

questions.question: What can we infer about Lily from the last paragraph?

choices.label: A
choices.text: She still wants to go back to her small town.

choices.label: B
choices.text: She is afraid of making new friends.

choices.label: C
choices.text: She has become braver and happier.

choices.label: D
choices.text: She doesn't like the city park.

questions.explanation: 最后一段提到莉莉不再悲伤，妈妈说她勇敢并尝试新事物，可以推断她变得更勇敢、更快乐，所以选C。A与文意相反；B与事实不符，她已经交了很多朋友；D文中说“She also likes walking in the city park.”，所以D错误。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "scary" in the last paragraph probably mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Frightening.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Interesting.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Easy.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Boring.

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，莉莉初到新地方感到害怕和悲伤，所以“scary”意思是“令人害怕的”，选A。B“有趣的”、C“容易的”、D“无聊的”都不符合语境。

title: The Kite That Carried a Wish
titleZh: 承载愿望的风筝
passage:
Every spring, Li Wei's grandfather takes him to the park to fly a kite. But this is not a common kite. It is a swallow kite with a long tail. It is made of paper and bamboo. Grandfather made it by hand many years ago.

In China, flying kites has a long history. Long ago, people flew kites to ask for good luck. They also wrote their wishes on the kite. When the kite flew high, they believed the sky would hear them.

This year, Li Wei has a wish. He wants to do well in his math test. "Write it on the kite," says Grandfather. Li Wei writes slowly: "I want to get an A." Then they run and the kite goes up. The wind is strong. The swallow dances in the blue sky.

Suddenly, the string breaks! The kite flies away. Li Wei is sad. "Don't worry," Grandfather says. "The sky has taken your wish. Now you must work for it."

Li Wei looks at the sky and smiles. He knows what to do. He will study hard every day. And next spring, he will write a new wish on the kite.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A boy learns to make a kite by hand.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A family tradition of flying kites carries wishes and hopes.

choices.label: C
choices.text: How to fly a kite in strong wind.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Why Chinese people like the sky.

questions.explanation: 全文围绕放风筝这一传统活动，以及爷爷和孙子通过风筝传递愿望和希望展开。A错在文中未讲男孩学做风筝；C只是细节；D太宽泛，没有扣住风筝和愿望。

questions.question: What did people long ago do when they flew kites?

choices.label: A
choices.text: They asked for good luck and wrote wishes on the kite.

choices.label: B
choices.text: They made kites with their friends.

choices.label: C
choices.text: They ran in the park every spring.

choices.label: D
choices.text: They sang songs to the sky.

questions.explanation: 第二段明确提到“Long ago, people flew kites to ask for good luck. They also wrote their wishes on the kite.”B、C、D在文中没有依据。

questions.question: Why does Li Wei smile at the end of the story?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Because he gets an A in the math test.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because he finds his kite again.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Because he understands he needs to work hard.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because his grandfather buys him a new kite.

questions.explanation: 爷爷说“The sky has taken your wish. Now you must work for it.”李伟微笑是因为他明白了要努力。A文中未发生；B、D与原文不符。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "string" mean in Chinese?

choices.label: A
choices.text: 线

choices.label: B
choices.text: 纸

choices.label: C
choices.text: 竹子

choices.label: D
choices.text: 尾巴

questions.explanation: 根据上下文“the string breaks”可知风筝的线断了，所以string意思是“线”。B、C、D分别是制作风筝的材料或风筝的一部分，不符合语境。

title: The Power of a Small 'Thank You'
titleZh: 一句“谢谢”的力量
topic: 心理学发现——表达感谢能让人更快乐
passage:
Many students think happiness comes from big things. They want a new phone or a high score. But a new study tells us something different. Small words like "thank you" can make us happy.

Dr. Smith is a scientist in a middle school. She asked 200 students to write three thank-you notes each week. The notes were for parents, friends or teachers. After eight weeks, these students felt happier than before. They also slept better and made more friends.

Why does saying thanks help? Dr. Smith says when we thank others, we think about the good things in our life. We feel lucky and loved. Our brain then makes us feel warm and happy. It is like a little gift to ourselves.

You do not need to write long letters. A short message or a few words are enough. You can thank your mother for breakfast. You can thank a classmate for helping you. You can even thank your dog for waiting for you.

So next time you feel sad, try to say "thank you". It is easy, free, and it works. A small word can bring a big smile.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Students should always get high scores.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Saying thank you can make people happier.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Writing long letters is good for students.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Dogs can help people feel warm.

questions.explanation: 文章开篇提出“小词如‘谢谢’能让我们快乐”，后文围绕这一观点展开研究，因此B是主旨。A项只是文中提到的“大事情”之一，不是主旨；C项与原文“不需要写长信”矛盾；D项只是感谢对象的一个例子，不是全文主旨。

questions.question: How many students did Dr. Smith ask to write thank-you notes?
questions.explanation: 文章第二段明确说“She asked 200 students”，因此B正确。A、C、D项的数字在文中均未出现，属于无中生有。

questions.question: What can we infer about students who wrote thank-you notes?

choices.label: A
choices.text: They became scientists later.

choices.label: B
choices.text: They stopped doing homework.

choices.label: C
choices.text: They may have better relationships with others.

choices.label: D
choices.text: They only thanked their parents.

questions.explanation: 文中说写感谢信的学生“made more friends”，朋友更多意味着人际关系可能更好，因此C是合理推断。A项文章未说他们后来成为科学家；B项与原文无关；D项与“感谢父母、朋友或老师”不符。

questions.question: What does the word "works" mean in the last paragraph?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Has a good effect.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Finds a job.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Makes a machine run.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Does hard work.

questions.explanation: 最后一段说“It is easy, free, and it works. A small word can bring a big smile.” 这里“works”指“有效果、起作用”，即A“有好的效果”。B“找到工作”、C“使机器运转”、D“做艰苦工作”都不符合语境。

title: A Special Saturday at the Bakery
titleZh: 面包店里特别的周六
passage:
Lily is a middle school student. Last Saturday, she visited her aunt's bakery. Her aunt works there every day. Lily wanted to know what a real job was like.

At 7 a.m., the bakery opened. Lily put on a white hat and an apron. Her first job was to put bread on the shelves. Then she helped clean the tables. At 10 a.m., many people came in. Lily smiled and said, "Good morning! Can I help you?" She felt a little tired, but she was happy.

At noon, Lily's aunt asked her, "So, what do you think of this job?" Lily thought for a moment. "It's hard work," she said. "You stand all day. But when people say 'thank you' and smile, it feels great."

Her aunt smiled. "That's why I love my job. Every job has its hard parts. But helping others makes it meaningful."

Lily learned something important that day. Work is not just about money. It is also about being useful and making people happy.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Lily's aunt owns a big bakery in the city.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Lily learned that work can be hard but meaningful.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Lily wants to be a baker when she grows up.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The bakery is very busy on Saturday mornings.

questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述莉莉在面包店体验工作，最后领悟到工作虽然辛苦但很有意义，故选B。A项是细节，不是全文主旨；C项文中未提及莉莉想成为面包师；D项只是文章部分内容，不能概括全文。

questions.question: What did Lily do at the bakery?

choices.label: A
choices.text: She made bread with her aunt.

choices.label: B
choices.text: She put bread on the shelves and cleaned tables.

choices.label: C
choices.text: She opened the bakery at 7 a.m.

choices.label: D
choices.text: She counted money for her aunt.

questions.explanation: 文中明确提到“Her first job was to put bread on the shelves. Then she helped clean the tables.”故选B。A项文中未提及她做面包；C项是面包店开门时间，不是莉莉做的；D项文中未提及数钱。

questions.question: What can we infer from the passage about Lily's aunt?

choices.label: A
choices.text: She wants Lily to work for her every weekend.

choices.label: B
choices.text: She thinks her job is boring.

choices.label: C
choices.text: She enjoys her job because she can help others.

choices.label: D
choices.text: She is too busy to talk with Lily.

questions.explanation: 根据姑姑的话“That's why I love my job... helping others makes it meaningful.”可以推断她喜欢自己的工作是因为能帮助别人，故选C。A项文中未提及；B项与姑姑热爱工作的态度相反；D项与文中姑姑和莉莉交谈的情节矛盾。

questions.question: What does the word "meaningful" in Paragraph 5 mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Interesting

choices.label: B
choices.text: Easy

choices.label: C
choices.text: Important and useful

choices.label: D
choices.text: Tiring

questions.explanation: 结合上下文，姑姑说帮助别人让工作变得“meaningful”，且文章最后说工作不只是为了钱，还在于有用和让人开心，故meaningful意为“有意义的、重要的”，选C。A项“有趣的”不准确；B项“容易的”与文中“hard work”矛盾；D项“累人的”是工作的特点，不是meaningful的含义。

title: Emma's Week Without Social Media
titleZh: 艾玛远离社交媒体的一周
topic: 社交媒体与青少年生活
passage:
Emma is a 15-year-old student. She loves using social media. Every day, she spends over three hours on her phone. She looks at pictures, watches short videos, and talks with friends online. But last month, her eyes hurt and she felt tired in class.

One Monday, Emma's teacher gave the class a challenge: no social media for a week. Emma thought it was impossible. On the first day, she felt worried. She kept touching her phone. But she had no new messages.

By Wednesday, Emma started to do other things. She read a book about animals. She played basketball with her brother. She also helped her mother cook dinner. "I feel calm," she said. "I have more time now."

On Sunday, Emma went online again. She saw many unread messages. But she didn't feel excited. "I don't need to check my phone every minute," she said. "Real life is more interesting." Now Emma uses social media for only 30 minutes a day. She feels happier and healthier.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Social media is bad for everyone.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Emma learned to use social media less and enjoy real life.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Emma's teacher gave her a phone.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Emma stopped using social media forever.

questions.explanation: 文章讲述艾玛在老师的挑战下减少社交媒体使用，并发现现实生活更有趣，最后每天只使用30分钟。选项B准确概括了主旨。A太绝对，文章并未说社交媒体对所有人都不好；C与原文不符，老师是给了一个挑战；D错误，艾玛并没有永远停止使用，而是减少到每天30分钟。

questions.question: How long did Emma spend on social media every day before the challenge?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Less than one hour.

choices.label: B
choices.text: About two hours.

choices.label: C
choices.text: More than three hours.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Thirty minutes.

questions.explanation: 文章第一段明确提到“Every day, she spends over three hours on her phone.”，即每天超过三小时。选项C正确。A、B、D均与原文数字不符，其中D是挑战后每天使用的时间。

questions.question: What can we infer about Emma from the last paragraph?

choices.label: A
choices.text: She will never use social media again.

choices.label: B
choices.text: She still feels worried when she sees messages.

choices.label: C
choices.text: She now thinks real life is more important than online life.

choices.label: D
choices.text: She wants to buy a new phone.

questions.explanation: 最后一段艾玛说“Real life is more interesting.”，并且现在每天只使用30分钟，感到更快乐健康，可以推断她认为现实生活比网络生活更重要。A过于绝对，她仍会使用社交媒体；B与原文“didn't feel excited”矛盾；D文章未提及。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "impossible" in Paragraph 2 mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Very easy.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Not able to happen.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Very interesting.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Not important.

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，艾玛每天花大量时间在社交媒体上，所以当老师提出一周不用社交媒体的挑战时，她认为这是“不可能的”。impossible意为“不可能的”，与B“Not able to happen”意思一致。A、C、D均不符合语境。

title: Saving Energy at School
titleZh: 在学校节约能源
passage:
Our school started a "Green Week" last month. The teachers told us that we should save energy. We use a lot of energy every day. Lights, computers, and air conditioners all need power. Most of our power comes from coal. Burning coal is bad for the air. So we must save energy.

In Green Week, we did many things. We turned off the lights when we left the classroom. We used both sides of the paper. We walked or rode bikes to school. We also planted ten trees in the school yard.

At the end of the week, our teacher showed us some numbers. Our school saved 20% of its electricity that week. We were very happy. The teacher said, "Saving energy is not just for one week. It is for every day."

Now we have a new rule. The last student to leave the classroom must turn off the lights and fans. We also have a "power monitor" in each class. His or her job is to check the lights and computers. I am the power monitor in my class. I feel proud. I think small actions can make a big difference.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Students should plant more trees at school.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Saving energy is important and everyone can help.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Air conditioners use too much power.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Green Week is the only time to save energy.

questions.explanation: 文章讲述了学校开展“绿色周”活动，学生们通过关灯、双面用纸、步行上学等方式节约能源，并强调节约能源不是一周的事，而是每天的事，最后提到小行动能带来大不同。因此主旨是节约能源很重要，每个人都能帮忙。A选项只提到植树，是细节；C选项只提到空调，是细节；D选项与文中“Saving energy is not just for one week. It is for every day.”矛盾。

questions.question: What did the students do during Green Week?

choices.label: A
choices.text: They left the lights on.

choices.label: B
choices.text: They used one side of the paper.

choices.label: C
choices.text: They walked or rode bikes to school.

choices.label: D
choices.text: They planted twenty trees.

questions.explanation: 文中第二段提到“We walked or rode bikes to school.”，所以C正确。A选项与“turned off the lights”相反；B选项与“used both sides of the paper”相反；D选项文中是“planted ten trees”，不是二十棵。

questions.question: What can we infer from the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The school saved 20% of its electricity in Green Week.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The writer is a teacher.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The writer thinks saving energy is only the power monitor's job.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The writer feels happy to be the power monitor.

questions.explanation: 文中最后一段作者说“I am the power monitor in my class. I feel proud.”，可以推断出作者作为电力监督员感到高兴和自豪，所以D正确。A选项是文中直接给出的数字，不是推断；B选项错误，作者是学生；C选项与文中“small actions can make a big difference”和每个人都要节约能源的意思不符。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "monitor" probably mean in Chinese?

choices.label: A
choices.text: 监督员

choices.label: B
choices.text: 显示器

choices.label: C
choices.text: 班长

choices.label: D
choices.text: 老师

questions.explanation: 根据上下文“His or her job is to check the lights and computers.”可知，power monitor的工作是检查灯和电脑，所以monitor在这里指“监督员”。B选项“显示器”是monitor的另一个意思，但不符合语境；C选项“班长”和D选项“老师”都不符合文中描述的工作内容。

title: The Boy Who Found a Hidden History
titleZh: 发现隐藏历史的男孩
passage:
Last summer, Jack was walking near a river in his town. He saw a small stone in the mud. It looked like a coin. He picked it up and took it home.

His father said, "This might be old. We should show it to a teacher." The next day, Jack brought the coin to his history teacher, Ms. Lee. She looked at it carefully. "This is over 500 years old," she said. "Where did you find it?"

Jack took Ms. Lee to the river. She called some people from a museum. They came and dug the ground. They found old walls, bones, and broken bowls. It was an old village!

"You found something very important," Ms. Lee told Jack. "This village can tell us about people long ago." Jack felt proud. He learned that history is not just in books. It can be under our feet.

Now Jack wants to be an archaeologist. He reads books about old things. He also joins a history club at school. He says, "Every small thing can be a big clue."

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Jack likes to play near the river.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A boy found an old coin and helped discover a village.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Ms. Lee is a history teacher.

choices.label: D
choices.text: History is only in books.

questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述了Jack发现古币并帮助博物馆人员发现古村落的故事，所以B正确。A只提到Jack喜欢在河边玩，不是主要内容；C只提到一个角色，不是主旨；D与文章最后一句意思相反。

questions.question: Where did Jack find the coin?

choices.label: A
choices.text: In his school.

choices.label: B
choices.text: In a museum.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Near a river.

choices.label: D
choices.text: In his garden.

questions.explanation: 文章第一段提到“Jack was walking near a river”，并且他在泥里发现了硬币，所以C正确。A、B、D在文中均未提到。

questions.question: What can we infer about Jack from the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: He is not interested in history.

choices.label: B
choices.text: He wants to learn more about the past.

choices.label: C
choices.text: He doesn't like his teacher.

choices.label: D
choices.text: He found the coin in a museum.

questions.explanation: 文章最后一段提到Jack想成为考古学家，读关于古物的书，并加入历史俱乐部，说明他对过去感兴趣并想了解更多，所以B正确。A与文章内容相反；C文中未提及；D与事实不符。

questions.question: The word "archaeologist" in the last paragraph probably means a person who ______.

choices.label: A
choices.text: studies old things and places

choices.label: B
choices.text: teaches history at school

choices.label: C
choices.text: works in a museum

choices.label: D
choices.text: looks for coins in rivers

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，Jack想成为考古学家，他读关于古物的书，并且文中提到博物馆人员挖掘古村落，可以推断考古学家是研究古老事物和地点的人，所以A正确。B、C、D都是与考古学家相关但不准确或过于片面的描述。

title: A New Way to Learn English
titleZh: 学英语的新方法
passage:
Many students find it hard to learn English. They think grammar is boring. They feel afraid to speak. But Li Hua, a 14-year-old boy from Beijing, has a different idea.

Last year, Li Hua started a small English club at his school. Every Friday afternoon, ten students meet in a classroom. They don't open their textbooks. They just talk in English. At first, they talk about simple things like food, sports and weekends. Later, they talk about their dreams and favorite books.

"We make many mistakes," says Li Hua. "But we are not afraid. We laugh and learn from them." The club also has a rule: no Chinese in the room. If someone speaks Chinese, he or she must sing an English song.

Now Li Hua's club has 25 members. Some shy students have become active speakers. Li Hua's English teacher, Ms. Wang, is happy. "The club is a great idea," she says. "Students learn best when they are relaxed and having fun."

Li Hua hopes more students will join the club. "English is not just a subject," he says. "It is a bridge to the world. Let's cross it together."

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: English grammar is boring for students.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A school English club helps students learn by talking.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Li Hua is a 14-year-old boy from Beijing.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Students should sing English songs in class.

questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述了李华创办英语俱乐部，通过自由交谈的方式帮助学生学习英语，因此B是主旨。A只是文章开头提到的部分学生的看法，不是主旨；C是细节，不是主旨；D是俱乐部的一条规则，不是主旨。

questions.question: What do students do in Li Hua's English club?

choices.label: A
choices.text: They read their English textbooks.

choices.label: B
choices.text: They write English stories.

choices.label: C
choices.text: They talk in English about different things.

choices.label: D
choices.text: They watch English movies.

questions.explanation: 根据第二段，俱乐部成员不打开课本，而是用英语谈论食物、运动、周末、梦想和书等不同话题，因此C正确。A与原文“They don't open their textbooks”相反；B和D在文中没有提到。

questions.question: What can we infer about shy students in the club?

choices.label: A
choices.text: They never speak English.

choices.label: B
choices.text: They become more confident over time.

choices.label: C
choices.text: They don't like the club.

choices.label: D
choices.text: They only sing English songs.

questions.explanation: 文章第四段提到“Some shy students have become active speakers”，说明害羞的学生逐渐变得积极开口说英语，因此可以推断他们变得更自信了。A与原文不符；C和D在文中没有依据。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "bridge" in the last paragraph mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A way to connect with the world.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A place to cross a river.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A subject in school.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A game for students.

questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“English is not just a subject. It is a bridge to the world. Let's cross it together.”可知，这里把英语比作连接世界的桥梁，意思是英语是通往世界的一种途径，因此A正确。B是bridge的字面意思，不符合语境；C和D与上下文无关。

title: The School Music Club
titleZh: 学校音乐俱乐部
passage:
Many students at Green Hill Middle School love music. Last month, the school started a music club. It meets every Friday afternoon in Room 305. Ms. Lee, the music teacher, leads the club.

At the first meeting, twelve students came. Some played the piano. Some played the guitar. Others liked to sing. Ms. Lee asked each student to play or sing a short song. Then she said, "Music is not only about playing well. It is about sharing feelings with others."

Tom is a quiet boy. He did not play any instrument before. He joined the club because his best friend Jack asked him to come. At first, Tom was afraid. He thought he could not do it well. But Ms. Lee gave him a small drum. She showed him how to hit it slowly and then quickly. Tom tried again and again. After two weeks, he could play a simple beat for the club's songs.

Now Tom loves the club. He says, "The drum is my voice. I feel happy when I play it." The club will give a show next month. All the students are excited. They practice hard every Friday. Ms. Lee smiles and says, "You are all musicians now. Just enjoy the music!"

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A music teacher tells students to play the piano well.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A school music club helps students enjoy and share music.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Tom learns to play the drum better than Jack.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Green Hill Middle School has many music rooms.

questions.explanation: 全文围绕学校音乐俱乐部展开，介绍其活动以及学生（尤其是Tom）在其中的成长和快乐，故B正确。A项只提到老师要求学生弹好钢琴，与原文不符；C项文中未比较Tom和Jack的鼓技；D项只是细节，不是主旨。

questions.question: When does the music club meet?

choices.label: B

choices.label: C

choices.label: D

questions.question: What can we infer about Tom from the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: He was good at playing the drum before.

choices.label: B
choices.text: He joined the club because he loved music.

choices.label: C
choices.text: He became more confident after joining the club.

choices.label: D
choices.text: He will leave the club next month.

questions.explanation: Tom起初害怕、认为自己做不好，后来经过练习能打简单的节拍，并说“The drum is my voice. I feel happy when I play it.”，说明他变得自信和快乐，故选C。A项与“did not play any instrument before”矛盾；B项他加入是因为朋友邀请；D项文中未提及他要离开。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "voice" in the passage mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A sound made by singing.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A way to show his feelings.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A loud noise from the drum.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A song he wrote for the club.

title: A New Way to School
titleZh: 上学新方式
passage:
Last year, Li Ming's father drove him to school every day. It took about 40 minutes. They often got stuck in traffic. Li Ming sometimes was late for class. He felt bad about it.

In March, a new subway line opened near Li Ming's home. Now he takes the subway to school. The ride takes only 20 minutes. He leaves home at 7:10 and arrives at school at 7:35. He is never late now.

Li Ming likes the subway. He can read a book or listen to English on the way. He also meets his classmates on the train. They talk and laugh together. It is fun.

Li Ming's father is happy, too. He doesn't need to drive in heavy traffic. He saves time and can have breakfast at home. He says, 'The subway is good for us. It is also good for the city. Fewer cars mean less air pollution.'

Now Li Ming walks to the subway station every morning. He says, 'I like my new way to school. It is fast, green and fun.'

choices.label: C
choices.text: He doesn't like having breakfast at home.

choices.label: D
choices.text: He meets Li Ming's classmates on the train.

questions.explanation: 文章第四段父亲说“The subway is good for us. It is also good for the city.”，因此B项正确。A项与原文矛盾；C项文中说父亲可以在家吃早饭，并非不喜欢；D项是李明在地铁上遇到同学，不是父亲。

questions.question: The word "green" in the last paragraph probably means ______.

choices.label: A
choices.text: good for the environment

choices.label: B
choices.text: having the color of grass

choices.label: C
choices.text: full of trees

choices.label: D
choices.text: new and modern

questions.explanation: 根据上文父亲提到“Fewer cars mean less air pollution.”，可知“green”在这里指环保的，对环境的益处，所以选A。B项是字面颜色，C项指长满树，D项指新式现代，均不符合语境。

title: The Little Free Library in Our Neighborhood
titleZh: 我们社区的迷你免费图书馆
passage:
Last spring, my sister Emma and I found an old wooden box near the park. It was broken and dirty. Most people walked past it, but Emma had a different idea. "Let's turn it into a little free library," she said. "People can take a book and leave a book. It's a way to share and help others."

At first, I thought it was too much work. But Emma is good at making plans. She asked our neighbors for old books. Mr. Lee, a retired teacher, gave us many storybooks. Mrs. Chen, who loves gardening, helped us paint the box bright blue. I fixed the broken wood with my dad's tools. After two weekends, the little library was ready. We put it near the park gate and filled it with books.

Now, every day after school, we see children and adults stopping by. Some take a book home. Some leave a new one. Emma and I feel happy because we gave something to our neighborhood. We didn't spend much money, but we spent time and love. That is what volunteering really means.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: How to make a wooden box.

choices.label: B
choices.text: How Emma and the writer started a little free library to help others.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Why Mr. Lee gave away his storybooks.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Where to find good books in the neighborhood.

questions.explanation: 文章讲述了Emma和作者把旧木箱改造成迷你免费图书馆，为社区服务的故事，B项概括了全文主旨。A项只是细节，C项只是其中一个帮助者，D项不是文章重点。

questions.question: Who helped paint the little library?

choices.label: A

choices.label: B

choices.label: C

questions.question: What can we infer about the writer at the beginning?

choices.label: B

choices.label: C

title: The Classroom Flea Market
titleZh: 教室里的跳蚤市场
passage:
Last Friday, Class 8 had a flea market in their classroom. Everyone brought old books, toys or cards and tried to sell them to classmates.

Lily brought ten storybooks. She sold eight of them for one yuan each. She kept the money in a small box. "I want to buy a new schoolbag," she said. "It costs fifty yuan. I still need more."

Tom had a different idea. He bought three old toy cars from Jack for two yuan each. Then he cleaned them and put a small sign on each: "Cool cars, five yuan." By the end of the day, all three cars were sold. Tom made nine yuan in total.

"You are like a little businessman!" Lily said. Tom smiled. "I just think about what people want," he answered. "You can do it too."

At the end of the market, Miss Li, their teacher, said, "Today you learned more than buying and selling. You learned to use your head and your hands. That is a real life lesson."

questions.question: What is the passage mainly about?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A class flea market and a lesson about money.

choices.label: B
choices.text: How to buy old books in a school.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Why students should not sell toys.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A teacher's busy Friday afternoon.

questions.explanation: 主旨题。文章围绕八年级教室跳蚤市场展开，重点写学生如何买卖和老师总结的理财课，A 最全面。B 只提到买旧书，片面；C 文中没有反对卖玩具；D 老师只在最后出现，不是文章中心。

questions.question: How much did Tom make from selling the toy cars?

choices.label: A

choices.label: B

choices.label: C

questions.question: What can we learn about Tom from the passage?

choices.label: A

choices.label: B

choices.label: C
choices.text: He wanted to buy a new schoolbag.

choices.label: D

questions.explanation: 推理题。Tom 低价买入旧玩具车，清洁后加价卖出，说明他善于动脑筋赚钱，B 正确。A 文中未提到他擅长打扫教室；C 想买新书包的是 Lily；D 文中没有说他不喜欢老师的课。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "businessman" mean in the passage?

choices.text: A person who buys and sells things.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A person who cleans old toys.

choices.label: C

choices.label: D

questions.explanation: 词义猜测题。Lily 称 Tom 像 "a little businessman"，因为 Tom 低价买进、高价卖出玩具车，所以 businessman 指“买卖东西的人”，A 正确。B 只提到清洁玩具，C 指老师，D 指做故事书的人，均不符合语境。

title: The Homework Robot
titleZh: 作业机器人
passage:
Tom is a middle school student. He likes science and inventing things. Last month, he made a small robot. He called it "Helper". Helper can move, speak and pick up small things.

Tom's little sister, Lily, always loses her pencils. Tom had an idea. He put a small box on Helper. Helper can find pencils on the floor. It picks them up and puts them in the box. Lily is very happy.

One day, Tom forgot his homework. He was worried. "Can Helper do my homework?" he thought. He put a pencil in Helper's hand. But Helper could not write. It just moved the pencil left and right. Then it dropped the pencil.

Tom laughed. "You are a good helper, but you are not a student," he said. "I must do my homework myself." Tom learned a lesson. Robots can help us with many things. But they cannot think like people. They cannot learn like people, either.

Now Tom is making Helper better. He wants Helper to help his mother find her keys. He also wants to learn more about robots. He hopes to be an inventor one day.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Tom's robot can do homework for him.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Robots can help people but cannot think like people.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Tom's sister Lily always loses her pencils.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Tom wants to be a teacher.

questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述Tom发明机器人Helper，它能帮忙捡铅笔，但不能替Tom写作业，最后Tom明白机器人能帮忙但不像人一样思考。B项概括了全文主旨。A项与原文相反，机器人不能写作业；C项只是文中一个细节；D项原文说Tom希望成为发明家，不是老师。

questions.question: What can Helper do according to the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Write homework.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Find and pick up pencils.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Find keys.

choices.label: D

questions.explanation: 根据第二段，Helper能在地板上找到铅笔，捡起来放进盒子里。A项错误，Helper不会写作业；C项错误，Tom想让它帮妈妈找钥匙，但还没实现；D项错误，文章说机器人不能像人一样学习。

questions.question: What can we infer from the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Tom will stop making robots.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Lily will do her homework with Helper.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Tom will make Helper more useful.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Helper can write if Tom teaches it.

questions.explanation: 文章最后一段说Tom正在改进Helper，想让它帮妈妈找钥匙，并希望成为发明家，可推断他会让Helper更有用。A项与原文相反；B项文中未提；D项与原文矛盾，Helper不能像人一样学习。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "inventor" mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A person who makes new things.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A person who sells robots.

choices.label: C

choices.label: D

title: The Little Green Team
titleZh: 小小绿色行动队
passage:
Last month, our teacher showed us a picture of a dirty river. The water was black, and fish were dead. We felt sad. "We can do something," said our teacher. So we started a club called the Little Green Team.

Every Saturday morning, we meet at the park. We pick up rubbish. We also put up signs that say "Keep Our Park Clean!" At first, only five students joined. Now there are twenty. We wear green hats and carry big bags.

One day, a little boy saw us working. He asked, "Why are you doing this?" We told him, "Because we want a clean world." He smiled and joined us. His mother also came to help.

Our teacher says, "Small actions can make a big difference." We believe that. If everyone helps, our city will be clean and beautiful. We will keep working. We hope more friends will join us.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A teacher showed a picture of a dirty river.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Students start a club to help the environment.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A little boy and his mother join a club.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The park is a good place to play.

questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述了学生们成立“小小绿色行动队”来保护环境。A、C只是文中细节，不是主旨；D文中未提及。

questions.question: How often do the students meet at the park?

choices.label: B

questions.question: What can we infer about the Little Green Team from the passage?

questions.question: What does the underlined word "difference" mean in the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A change or effect.

choices.label: B

title: A New Habit, A New Me
titleZh: 新习惯，新自我
passage:
Last year, I was not healthy. I often felt tired. I liked to watch TV and play computer games. I did not like sports. My mother said, "You need to exercise." But I did not listen.

One day, I could not run fast in P.E. class. I felt sad. My friend Tom said, "Let's run together every morning. It's fun." I thought it was a good idea. So we started to run in the park near our school.

At first, it was very hard. I wanted to stop. But Tom said, "Don't give up. You can do it." I kept running. After two weeks, I felt better. I could run for 20 minutes without stopping.

Now, I run every morning. I also eat more vegetables and fruit. I drink water instead of cola. I sleep for eight hours every night. I feel happy and strong. My mother is proud of me.

Exercise is not boring. It is a good way to keep healthy. If you want to be healthy, start today. You will feel great!

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Watching TV is bad for your eyes.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Exercise and good habits can make you healthy.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Running in the park is fun.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Friends should always help each other.

questions.explanation: 本文讲述了作者通过跑步和养成健康习惯（多吃蔬菜水果、喝水、早睡）变得健康的故事，因此B项是主旨。A项只是文中提到的一个细节，不是主旨；C项是具体活动，不是全文主旨；D项虽然提到朋友帮助，但不是文章的核心主题。

questions.question: How did the writer feel at first when he started running?

choices.label: B

choices.label: A

choices.label: D

questions.explanation: Tom邀请作者一起跑步，并在作者想放弃时鼓励他“Don't give up. You can do it.”，可以推断Tom擅长跑步且乐于鼓励他人。B项与Tom喜欢跑步矛盾；C项文中只说Tom是朋友，不是兄弟；D项文中没有提到Tom的饮食。

questions.question: The underlined word "proud" in the passage probably means ______.

choices.label: A
choices.text: angry

choices.label: B
choices.text: worried

choices.label: C
choices.text: pleased and satisfied

choices.label: D
choices.text: surprised

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，作者变得健康、快乐、强壮，妈妈因此感到“proud”，即“骄傲的、自豪的”，与pleased and satisfied（高兴且满意）意思最接近。A项angry（生气的）和B项worried（担心的）与语境不符；D项surprised（惊讶的）虽然可能，但不如C项准确，因为妈妈的情感主要是自豪和满意。

title: The Teacher Who Asked Why
titleZh: 爱问“为什么”的老师
passage:
In a small town, there was a science teacher named Mr. Lee. He did not like to give students answers. Instead, he always asked, "Why do you think so?"

One day, his students wanted to know why the sky is blue. Mr. Lee did not tell them. He gave each group a glass of water and a small light. "Try it," he said. The students were confused at first. But they played with the light and water. Slowly, they found that the light changed when it went through the water. They were excited.

The next week, a boy named Tom asked, "Why does ice float on water?" Again, Mr. Lee did not answer. He gave the class some ice and water. The students watched and talked. They made a small boat from ice. It floated! They learned that ice is lighter than water.

Some parents were worried. They said, "You never teach. You just ask questions." Mr. Lee smiled. "I teach them to think," he said. "Answers are easy to forget, but thinking stays with you."

At the end of the year, Tom said, "Mr. Lee's class is hard, but I love it. I learn to find answers myself."

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Mr. Lee is a popular science teacher.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Students should not ask questions in class.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Mr. Lee teaches by letting students find answers themselves.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Parents always know what is best for their children.

questions.explanation: 文章通过两个例子（天空为什么是蓝色、冰为什么浮在水上）说明李老师不直接给答案，而是让学生自己探索，因此C正确。A虽提及受欢迎，但非主旨；B与文章相反；D文中未提。

questions.question: What can we infer about Tom from the last paragraph?

choices.label: A
choices.text: He dislikes Mr. Lee's class.

choices.label: B
choices.text: He thinks finding answers himself is helpful.

choices.label: C
choices.text: He wants to be a science teacher.

choices.label: D
choices.text: He is angry with Mr. Lee.

questions.explanation: 汤姆说“I learn to find answers myself”，表明他认为自己找答案很有帮助，因此B正确。A和D与文意相反；C文中未提。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "confused" in Paragraph 2 mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Not able to understand.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Very happy.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Feeling tired.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ready to answer.

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，学生一开始不明白老师为什么只给水和灯，所以“confused”意为“困惑的，不理解的”，A正确。B、C、D均不符合语境。

title: The AI Helper in Our School Library
titleZh: 学校图书馆里的人工智能助手
passage:
Our school library has a new helper. Its name is Xiao Zhi. It is a small robot with a screen. Xiao Zhi uses AI to help students.

Last Monday, I went to the library to find a book about animals. I didn't know where to look. Xiao Zhi came to me and asked, "What do you need?" I told it, "I want a book about elephants." In two seconds, it showed me the right shelf on its screen. It even told me the book was on the third shelf, next to the window.

Xiao Zhi can do more than find books. It can also read stories to young students. It speaks slowly and clearly. Many children sit around it and listen. But Xiao Zhi is not perfect. It sometimes makes mistakes. Once, it gave a wrong answer about a math problem. Our librarian, Ms. Li, says, "AI is a tool. It helps us, but we still need to think by ourselves."

I think Xiao Zhi is cool. It makes the library more fun. But I also remember Ms. Li's words. AI can help us, but it cannot take the place of our own brains.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A school library has a new AI robot that helps students but has limits.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Students in a school library love reading animal books.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A librarian teaches students how to use AI.

choices.label: D
choices.text: AI robots will replace teachers in schools.

questions.explanation: 文章主要介绍学校图书馆的新AI机器人小智，它能帮助学生但也会犯错，最后强调AI是工具，不能代替思考。A概括了全文。B只是细节；C不是重点；D与文意相反，文中明确说AI不能代替大脑。

questions.question: What did Xiao Zhi do for the writer last Monday?

questions.question: What can we infer from Ms. Li's words?

choices.label: A
choices.text: AI is not useful at all.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Students should not use AI.

choices.label: C
choices.text: AI should be used together with our own thinking.

choices.label: D
choices.text: AI will soon take the place of librarians.

questions.explanation: 李老师说：“AI是工具。它帮助我们，但我们仍然需要自己思考。” 可以推断出AI应与我们自己的思考结合使用。C正确。A、B太绝对；D与文意相反。

questions.question: The word "perfect" in the passage is closest in meaning to ______.

choices.label: A
choices.text: without any mistakes

choices.label: B
choices.text: very fast

choices.label: C
choices.text: quite small

choices.label: D
choices.text: easy to use

questions.explanation: 根据后文“它有时会犯错。有一次，它给了一个错误的数学题答案。”可知，perfect在此意为“完美的，没有错误的”，与A最接近。B、C、D均不符合上下文。

title: The Clever Bird That Helps Its Friends
titleZh: 帮助朋友的聪明鸟
passage:
Many people think only humans can help each other. But some animals do this too. A small bird called the Arabian babbler lives in groups. These birds often help their friends in a very special way.

When a babbler finds food, it does not eat alone. It calls its friends to share the meal. But here is the surprising part: the bird that gives food may get help later. If it is in danger, its friends will come to save it. This is like a deal: "I help you today, and you help me tomorrow."

Scientists watched these birds for many years. They found that babblers remember who helped them. They also remember who did not help. When a bird does not share, others may stop helping it. So the birds learn to be kind and fair.

Why do they do this? Living in a group is safer. When all birds help each other, the whole group is stronger. This behavior shows that even small animals can understand the importance of teamwork.

So next time you see birds, watch them carefully. They may be doing something much smarter than you think.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Birds like to eat food alone.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Some animals help each other like humans.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Scientists study birds for fun.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Arabian babblers are the only smart animals.

questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述一些动物（如阿拉伯鸫鹛）会像人类一样互相帮助。A 项与原文相反；C 项不是文章重点；D 项过于绝对，文章只说‘even small animals can understand teamwork’，并未说它们是唯一聪明的动物。

questions.question: What does an Arabian babbler do when it finds food?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It eats the food quickly by itself.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It hides the food from others.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It calls its friends to share the food.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It gives the food to scientists.

questions.explanation: 根据第二段‘When a babbler finds food, it does not eat alone. It calls its friends to share the meal.’可知，它找到食物时会叫朋友一起分享。A、B 与原文相反；D 无中生有。

questions.question: What can we infer from the passage about babblers?

choices.label: A
choices.text: They are selfish and never share food.

choices.label: B
choices.text: They remember who helps and who does not.

choices.label: C
choices.text: They live alone and do not need friends.

choices.label: D
choices.text: They only help their family members.

questions.explanation: 根据第三段‘They found that babblers remember who helped them. They also remember who did not help.’可以推断出它们能记住谁帮助过它们，谁没有。A、C、D 均与原文不符。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "deal" in Paragraph 2 mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A game played by birds.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A type of food.

choices.label: C

choices.label: D

questions.explanation: 根据第二段中‘I help you today, and you help me tomorrow.’可知，这里的 deal 指的是‘互相帮助的约定’。A、B、D 均不符合语境。

title: A Letter from Space
titleZh: 来自太空的一封信
passage:
Li Wei is a middle school student in Beijing. He loves space. He has many books about stars and rockets. Last month, his class joined a special program. They could send a letter to an astronaut on the space station.

Li Wei wrote a short letter. He asked, "What is it like to live in space?" Two weeks later, he got a reply. The astronaut's name is Wang Ping. She wrote, "Life in space is fun but different. We float in the air. We sleep in special bags. We cannot take a shower. We use wet towels."

Wang Ping also said, "The best part is the view. The Earth is blue and beautiful. But I miss my family and Chinese food." Li Wei was very excited. He shared the letter with his class. His teacher said, "Space is far, but our dreams can take us there."

Now Li Wei studies harder. He wants to be an astronaut one day. He says, "I will work hard and never give up."

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: How to write a letter to an astronaut.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Li Wei's dream of space and his letter from an astronaut.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The life of an astronaut on the space station.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Why Chinese food is important in space.

questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述了李伟对太空的热爱、他写信给宇航员并收到回信，以及他因此更加努力学习想成为宇航员的故事。A项只是细节，C项只涉及信的内容，D项是无关细节。

questions.question: What did Wang Ping say about life in space?

choices.label: A
choices.text: She can take a shower every day.

choices.label: B
choices.text: She sleeps in a special bag.

choices.label: C
choices.text: She eats only Chinese food.

choices.label: D
choices.text: She feels bored in space.

questions.explanation: 文章中提到王萍说“We sleep in special bags.”，所以B正确。A项与“We cannot take a shower.”矛盾；C项文中只说想念中餐，并非只吃中餐；D项文中说“Life in space is fun”，并非无聊。

questions.question: What can we infer about Li Wei from the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: He will become an astronaut soon.

choices.label: B
choices.text: He doesn't like his school subjects.

choices.label: C
choices.text: He is encouraged by the astronaut's reply.

choices.label: D
choices.text: He wants to visit the space station now.

questions.explanation: 从文中“Li Wei was very excited.”和“Now Li Wei studies harder. He wants to be an astronaut one day.”可以推断出他受到宇航员回信的鼓励。A项“很快成为宇航员”无法推断；B项与“studies harder”矛盾；D项文中未提及。

questions.question: What does the teacher mean by saying "Space is far, but our dreams can take us there"?

choices.label: A
choices.text: We can travel to space easily.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Dreams are not real.

choices.label: C
choices.text: If we work hard, we can achieve our dreams.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Space is too far to reach.

questions.explanation: 老师的话意思是：太空虽然遥远，但梦想可以带我们去那里，即通过努力可以实现梦想。A项“容易”错误；B项否定梦想；D项只强调远，未体现梦想的力量。

title: A Small Change in Eating Habits
titleZh: 饮食习惯的小改变
passage:
Lily is a 14-year-old student. She loves hamburgers, French fries and cola. She often eats them for lunch at school. Her mother tells her these foods are not healthy. But Lily does not listen.

One day, Lily feels tired in P.E. class. She cannot run fast. Her teacher says, "You need to eat well and exercise more." Lily is worried. She goes to see a doctor. The doctor says, "Too much fast food is bad for you. You should eat more vegetables and fruit. Drink water, not cola."

Lily decides to change. She eats an apple every morning. For lunch, she has rice, chicken and vegetables. She drinks water. She also walks to school every day.

After two months, Lily feels much better. She can run fast again. She says, "Healthy food makes me strong. I will keep this good habit."

questions.question: What is the passage mainly about?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Lily's favorite fast food.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Lily changes her eating habits and feels better.

choices.label: C
choices.text: How to run fast in P.E. class.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The doctor's advice on exercise.

questions.explanation: 文章讲述Lily从不健康饮食到改变习惯并感觉更好的过程，B概括准确。A只提到她喜欢的快餐，不是主旨；C和D只涉及文章一小部分内容，不能概括全文。

questions.question: What does Lily often eat for lunch at school at the beginning?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Rice, chicken and vegetables.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Apples and bananas.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Hamburgers, French fries and cola.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Bread and milk.

questions.explanation: 文章第一段明确说Lily often eats hamburgers, French fries and cola for lunch，所以选C。A是她改变后的午餐；B和D文中未提及。

questions.question: Why does Lily decide to change her eating habits?

choices.label: A

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because she wants to be a doctor.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Because she feels tired and cannot run fast.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because she doesn't like hamburgers anymore.

questions.explanation: 文章第二段说Lily在体育课上感到累、跑不快，老师建议她吃好并多锻炼，她担心并去看医生，之后决定改变，因此选C。A虽然妈妈告诉她，但她没听；B和D文中没有依据。

questions.question: What does the word "keep" mean in the last paragraph?

choices.label: A
choices.text: 保持

choices.label: B
choices.text: 丢弃

choices.label: C
choices.text: 忘记

choices.label: D
choices.text: 改变

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，Lily说“I will keep this good habit.”，意思是她会继续保持这个好习惯，所以keep意为“保持”，选A。B、C、D与句意不符。

title: A Small Park in the City
titleZh: 城市里的小公园
passage:
Mr. Chen lives in a big city. There are many tall buildings and busy streets around his home. Every morning, he goes to a small park near his house. The park is not big, but it is quiet and green. There are many trees, flowers, and a small lake.

In the park, Mr. Chen meets his friends. They do morning exercises together. Sometimes they play chess under a big tree. They talk about their families and the city. Mr. Chen says, "The city is busy, but this park is our quiet place."

Many children come to the park after school. They play games and feed the ducks by the lake. Some old people walk their dogs. Everyone likes this small park.

Last year, the city wanted to build a new road through the park. Many people were worried. They wrote letters to the city office. They said, "Please keep our park!" The city listened. The new road was built in another place. Now the park is still there, and people are very happy.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A man likes to play chess.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A small park is important to people in a city.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Children like to feed ducks.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The city is building a new road.

questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述城市里一个小公园对人们的重要性，以及人们如何保护它。A、C、D都只是文章中的细节，不是主旨。

questions.question: What does Mr. Chen do in the park in the morning?

choices.label: A
choices.text: He reads books.

choices.label: B
choices.text: He plays games with children.

choices.label: C
choices.text: He does morning exercises with friends.

choices.label: D
choices.text: He walks his dog.

questions.explanation: 文章第二段提到'They do morning exercises together.'，所以C正确。A、B、D虽然文中提到孩子们做游戏、老人遛狗，但不是Mr. Chen早上做的事。

questions.question: Why did many people write letters to the city office?

choices.label: A
choices.text: They wanted a new road.

choices.label: B
choices.text: They wanted to keep the park.

choices.label: C
choices.text: They wanted more trees.

choices.label: D
choices.text: They wanted to build a lake.

questions.explanation: 文章最后一段说'They said, "Please keep our park!"'，说明人们写信是为了保留公园，所以B正确。A与文章相反，C和D文中没有提到。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "worried" in the last paragraph mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Happy

choices.label: B
choices.text: Angry

choices.label: C
choices.text: Afraid

choices.label: D
choices.text: Tired

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，城市要修路穿过公园，人们担心公园会消失，所以'worried'意思是'担心、害怕'，与C（Afraid）最接近。A（高兴）、B（生气）、D（疲倦）都不符合语境。

title: The Kite That Carried a Wish
titleZh: 承载心愿的风筝
topic: 传统文化——风筝与放风筝的习俗
passage:
Every spring, Li Ming's grandfather takes him to the park to fly a kite. The kite is not big, but it has a long tail and a bright red color. On the kite, there is a picture of a swallow. "In China, kites are not just toys," Grandpa says. "They carry good wishes."

Li Ming learns that kites were first made in China more than 2,000 years ago. They were made of wood and bamboo. Later, people used paper and silk. In the past, people flew kites to ask for good weather and a good harvest. Some people wrote their wishes on the kite before flying it.

Today, Li Ming writes his wish on the kite, too. He writes, "I hope my family stays healthy." Then he runs with the kite. The wind lifts it high into the sky. Grandpa smiles and says, "Your wish is now with the wind. It will come true."

Li Ming doesn't know if the wish will really come true, but he feels happy. Flying kites is a family tradition. It connects him to his grandfather and to Chinese culture. Every spring, he looks forward to this special time.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: How to make a kite in China.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The history and meaning of flying kites in China.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Why Li Ming's grandfather likes spring.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The best way to write a wish on a kite.

questions.explanation: 文章主要介绍了中国风筝的历史（2000多年前出现）以及放风筝的文化意义（承载愿望），并以李明放风筝的故事为例。A 项只提到制作风筝，C 项只提到爷爷喜欢春天，D 项只提到在风筝上写愿望，都不全面。B 项概括了文章的主要内容。

questions.question: What did people in the past fly kites for?

choices.label: A
choices.text: To have fun with their family.

choices.label: B
choices.text: To sell them for money.

choices.label: C
choices.text: To ask for good weather and a good harvest.

choices.label: D
choices.text: To show their love for swallows.

questions.explanation: 文章第二段明确指出："In the past, people flew kites to ask for good weather and a good harvest." 所以 C 项正确。A、B、D 项在文中均未提及。

questions.question: What can we infer about Li Ming from the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: He doesn't believe in wishes at all.

choices.label: B
choices.text: He values the time with his grandfather.

choices.label: C
choices.text: He wants to make kites by himself.

choices.label: D
choices.text: He only flies kites in summer.

questions.explanation: 文章最后一段提到：李明虽然不确定愿望是否会实现，但他感到快乐，并且每年春天都期待这个特别的时刻。这说明他珍惜和爷爷一起放风筝的时光，所以 B 项正确。A 项与原文"he feels happy"矛盾；C 项文中未提及；D 项与"Every spring"不符。

questions.question: What does the underlined word "connects" in the last paragraph probably mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Joins together

choices.label: B
choices.text: Takes away

choices.label: C
choices.text: Looks after

choices.label: D
choices.text: Picks up

questions.explanation: 根据上下文："It connects him to his grandfather and to Chinese culture." 意思是放风筝这一传统把李明和爷爷以及中国文化联系在一起。connect 意为"连接、联系"，与 join together 意思相近。B 项"拿走"、C 项"照顾"、D 项"捡起"都不符合语境。

title: Why We Forget Where We Put Things
titleZh: 为什么我们会忘记东西放在哪里
passage:
Have you ever looked for your keys for ten minutes? Many people have. Scientists say this is normal. Our brains are busy. They cannot remember every small thing.

Dr. Lee is a scientist. She studies memory. She says we often put things down without thinking. For example, you come home and drop your keys on the table. You do not think, "I am putting my keys here." So your brain does not make a memory of it. Later, you cannot find them.

One easy way to help is to always put things in the same place. If your keys always go in a small box, your hand will remember. You do not need to think about it.

Another way is to say the place out loud. When you put your glasses on the desk, say, "My glasses are on the desk." Hearing your own voice helps your brain remember.

Dr. Lee also says sleep is important. When you sleep, your brain stores memories. If you do not sleep well, you may forget more.

So the next time you lose your keys, do not worry. You are not lazy. Your brain is just busy. Try a small habit, and life will be easier.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Why people are lazy and forgetful.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Why we forget things and how to remember them.

choices.label: C
choices.text: How to find your keys quickly.

choices.label: D
choices.text: How to sleep well at night.

questions.explanation: 文章主要讲我们为什么会忘记东西，以及如何记住它们。A 说人懒惰，文章明确说“You are not lazy”，错误；C 只提到找钥匙，太片面；D 只提到睡觉，也是细节。

questions.question: Why do we often forget where we put our keys?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Because we are too lazy.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because our brains are busy and do not make a memory.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Because the keys are too small.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because we do not like the keys.

questions.explanation: 文章第二段说我们常常不假思索地放下东西，大脑没有形成记忆。A 文章最后说“You are not lazy”，错误；C 和 D 文中没有提到。

questions.question: What can we learn from Dr. Lee's advice?

choices.label: A
choices.text: We should always buy new keys.

choices.label: B
choices.text: We should never put things down.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Good habits can help us remember things.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Sleeping less can make us remember more.

questions.explanation: 文章建议把东西放在固定地方、说出位置、睡好觉，这些都是好习惯，能帮助记忆。A 文中没提；B 太绝对；D 与文章相反，文章说睡眠不好会忘得更多。

questions.question: What does the word "stores" mean in the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Buys things from shops.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Keeps something for later use.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Throws away.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Looks for.

questions.explanation: 文章说“When you sleep, your brain stores memories.” 意思是睡觉时大脑把记忆保存起来，所以 stores 是“保存、储存”的意思。A 是“购物”，C 是“扔掉”，D 是“寻找”，都不符合。

title: A Special Job at the Zoo
titleZh: 动物园里的特别工作
passage:
Many students dream of easy jobs. But some jobs are very special. My uncle Tom works at a zoo. His job is to take care of the baby animals.

Every morning, Tom gets to the zoo at seven. He feeds the baby pandas and cleans their room. He also plays with them. "It's like being a parent," he says. "They need love and care."

Tom's day is busy. He gives the baby animals milk and fruit. He checks their health. He writes down what they eat and how they play. Sometimes he works at night. He must stay with a sick baby animal.

Tom loves his job. "I don't make much money," he says. "But when a baby animal grows up healthy, I feel very happy." He also teaches children about animals. "I want them to love animals too," he says.

Tom says his job is not for everyone. You must be kind, careful, and strong. But for Tom, it is the best job in the world.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Tom works at a zoo and takes care of baby animals.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Tom wants to make a lot of money.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Baby animals are easy to take care of.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Children should not visit zoos.

questions.explanation: 文章介绍了Tom在动物园照顾幼小动物的工作，A概括了全文。B与原文“I don't make much money”矛盾；C文中说照顾动物需要爱心和细心，并非容易；D文中提到Tom教孩子们爱护动物，并非说不该参观动物园。

questions.question: What does Tom do every morning at the zoo?

choices.label: A
choices.text: He cleans the zoo gates.

choices.label: B
choices.text: He feeds the baby pandas and cleans their room.

choices.label: C
choices.text: He teaches children about animals.

choices.label: D
choices.text: He works at night.

questions.explanation: 根据第二段“He feeds the baby pandas and cleans their room”可知B正确。A原文未提及；C是Tom的额外工作，不是每天早晨做的事；D是“有时”发生，不是每天早晨。

questions.question: What can we infer about Tom from the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: He doesn't like his job.

choices.label: B
choices.text: He thinks his job is easy.

choices.label: C
choices.text: He cares more about animals than money.

choices.label: D
choices.text: He only works during the day.

questions.explanation: Tom说钱不多，但看到动物健康成长就很开心，可以推断他更关心动物而非金钱，C正确。A与“loves his job”矛盾；B文中说需要细心和强壮，并不容易；D与“Sometimes he works at night”矛盾。

questions.question: The word "care" in Paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.

choices.label: A
choices.text: money

choices.label: B
choices.text: food

choices.label: C
choices.text: attention and love

choices.label: D
choices.text: a safe place

questions.explanation: 根据第二段“They need love and care”以及上下文，care指对动物的关心和爱护，与C“关注和爱”意思最接近。A、B、D均不符合语境。

title: My Digital Detox Weekend
titleZh: 我的数字排毒周末
passage:
Last Friday, my parents gave me a challenge: no social media for a whole weekend. At first, I thought it would be easy. But soon I felt worried. I always check my phone before bed. I like to see what my friends are doing.

On Saturday morning, I woke up and reached for my phone. Then I remembered the challenge. I put it down and went outside. I played basketball with my brother. We had a lot of fun. In the afternoon, I read a book. It was about a boy and his dog. I finished it in two hours.

On Sunday, I helped my mom cook lunch. We made noodles together. She told me funny stories about her childhood. I laughed a lot. Later, I wrote a letter to my best friend. I told her about my weekend. She called me and said, "That sounds great! Maybe I should try it too."

Now I know I can live without social media for a short time. I still use it, but I don't check it all the time. I have more time for real life.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Social media is bad for teenagers.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The writer had a good time without social media.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The writer's parents are very strict.

choices.label: D
choices.text: How to make noodles with mom.

questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述了作者在周末挑战不使用社交媒体，结果过得很开心，并发现可以短暂离开社交媒体。A项说社交媒体对青少年有害，文中并未提到；C项说父母很严格，文中只是给了挑战，并非严格；D项只是其中一个细节，不是主旨。

questions.question: What did the writer do on Saturday afternoon?

choices.label: A

choices.label: B
choices.text: Cooked lunch.

choices.label: C

choices.label: D

questions.explanation: 根据第二段“In the afternoon, I read a book.”可知，周六下午作者读书。A项是周六早上的活动；B项是周日的活动；D项是周日下午的活动。

questions.question: Why did the writer feel worried at first?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Because the challenge was too hard.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because he had no friends.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Because he lost his phone.

choices.label: D
